title: 1 · Jyutping: initials and finals
blurb: Read any Jyutping syllable aloud roughly right, and know the letters that do not sound the way English spells them.

title: 2 · The six tones, numbered 1 to 6
blurb: Hear and say the six Cantonese tones, tell tone twins apart, and read the tone numbers in Jyutping.

title: 3 · First characters: strokes and radicals
blurb: Recognize your first characters, see how they are built from parts, and spot the 口 that marks spoken-Cantonese words.

title: 4 · Hello, thanks and sorry: 唔該 and 多謝
blurb: Greet people, thank them the right way (唔該 or 多謝), apologize, say goodbye, and order a drink.

title: 5 · 係 (to be) and the pronouns 我, 你, 佢
blurb: Say who people are with 係 and 唔係, use I, you, he, she, we and they, and add 'too' with 都.

title: 6 · Introducing yourself: 我叫…, 我係美國人
blurb: Give your name and family name, ask someone theirs, and say where you are from, where you live and what you speak.

title: 7 · 唔 (not) and yes/no questions: 係唔係, 好唔好
blurb: Say 'not' with 唔, ask yes/no questions like 去唔去？, and answer them without a word for yes or no.

title: 8 · Question words: 咩, 邊個, 邊度, 幾時, 點解
blurb: Ask what, who, where, when, why and how, with the question word right where the answer goes.

title: 9 · Numbers: 一 to 十, 百, 千, 萬
blurb: Count from one to a hundred thousand, choose between 兩 and 二, and read phone numbers.

title: 10 · Classifiers: 個, 本, 杯, 張, and 'my' with 我本書
blurb: Count, point at and own things the Cantonese way: number, this or that, or owner + classifier + noun.

title: 11 · 嘅: my, your, his (我嘅, 佢嘅)
blurb: Say whose something is: my phone, Anna's number, it's mine, with the owner first and 嘅.

title: 12 · Family and age
blurb: Name your family on both sides, say how many people are in it, and ask and give ages without 係.

title: 13 · 喺 (at, in), not 係: 我喺香港
blurb: Say where things and people are, and where you do things, with 喺 and the place before the verb.

title: 14 · 有 and 冇: have, and there is (never 唔有)
blurb: Say what you have and don't have, what there is nearby, and ask and answer with 有冇.

title: 15 · Sentence-final particles: 呀, 啦, 吖, 呢
blurb: Sound friendly instead of blunt: soften questions, make requests, invite, and ask back with the right particle.

title: 16 · Money and prices: 幾多錢？, 蚊, 平啲
blurb: Ask what things cost, understand prices in 蚊 and 毫, haggle a little and pay.

title: 17 · Ordering food and drink: 唔該, 要, 埋單
blurb: Order drinks and dishes at a cha chaan teng or a dim sum place, with the right classifier, and ask for the check.

title: 18 · Clock time and dates: 幾點？, 三點半, 星期一
blurb: Ask and tell the time, name the days and dates, and put the time word before the verb.

title: 19 · My day: time and place before the verb
blurb: Describe your day in Cantonese order: who, when, where, how, then what you do.

title: 20 · Want, can, like: 想, 可以, 識, 會, 鍾意, 要
blurb: Say what you would like, need, know how to do, may do and enjoy, and what will happen.

title: 21 · Choices and 'also': A 定 B？ and 都
blurb: Ask 'this or that?', join two things with 'and', and say 'me too' the Cantonese way.

title: 22 · Describing and comparing: 好, 太, 幾, 過 (no 係)
blurb: Describe people, food, weather and prices, say "too" and "quite", and compare two things with 過.

title: 23 · 咗: done; 冇 (didn't) and 未 (not yet)
blurb: Say what you have done, what you didn't do, and what you haven't done yet, and ask 'have you … yet?'.

title: 24 · 緊 and 過: doing it now, and ever done it
blurb: Say what you are doing right now, ask 'have you ever…?', and tell 過 apart from 咗.

title: 25 · 去 and 嚟: going and coming; 搭車, 坐地鐵
blurb: Say where you are going and how: by MTR, bus, taxi or on foot, and get on and off.

title: 26 · Directions: 左邊, 右邊, 直行, 對面
blurb: Ask the way, follow simple directions, and say where a place is: across from, next to, in front of, behind.

title: 27 · Suggestions and invitations: 不如…？, 一齊…吖
blurb: Suggest plans, invite friends, say yes or 'next time', and tell someone not to worry.
